learnerStatement: Simulated learner. This review finds problems; it is not evidence that anyone learned.
learnerBoundary: Everyday numeracy, simple charts, comparing numbers and familiar household objects; no domain-specific theory assumed.

observations.prediction: Selected About half (50%), then Lock it in. Initial 1,000 km displayed 6.8%.
observations.exploration: Pressed Space station: 400 km, 19.8 degrees, 3.0%. Pressed Geostationary: 35,786 km, 81.3 degrees, 42.4%; Show me why unlocked.
observations.reveal: Not quite identified about 40%; compared current 42% to prior 3.0%. Explained grazing sightline, unseen poles, infinite height needed for half, and horizon dish view.
observations.visual: Inline CUA screenshot inspected: blue circular boundary nearly surrounds the dark orthographic globe; red below-satellite point, numeric percentage and controls legible. Bottom reveal action touched viewport edge.
observations.isolation: No-history evaluation preview banner present. Trust chrome 10/10 visible, ignored.
references: CUA tab 543884107 prediction/exploration/reveal snapshots and inline screenshot; no screenshot file saved.
